risk_note: RV2 (ledger). Read-only port getOrderNets(trx, { appId, orderKey }) for settlement (settlement-plan B2-04h, BR-FUND-08, BR-FUND-19 ④⑤): in the caller's transaction one read-only SELECT over ledger_vouchers / ledger_entries by (app_id, order_key) returns the net per (beneficiary, role), the platform's booked net and the order's net on UNION_RECEIVABLE, with the same sign and grouping as db/invariants/ledger/04_beneficiary-net.sql; the sums run in a pure function with @couli/money only. Platform-level R13 RESTORE vouchers without a beneficiary count toward the receivable net. A voucher whose beneficiary and role are set but whose role is outside the contract enum rejects with ORDER_HISTORY_INVALID rather than being dropped. No locks, no writes, no own transaction.
